score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY and T-SCALE-FIT pass on the page's components (6 sizes on the framework scale, radii 8, 14 and full, spacing 100% on 4px); T-DRIFT-PAIRS finds only surface pairs that do different jobs; 8 of 15 fill colours are one-offs, which keeps it below 9.
